question: What is worshipped as the wheel of waves of awareness?
premises: The one lord of awareness has an inner creative intuition as his body-form.
That form may appear as gentle or as another measured manifestation.
This is worshipped as the wheel of waves of awareness.
inference: The wheel of awareness is the inner intuitive manifestation of the one lord, appearing in varied forms.
uncertainties: anyanmitaṃ could suggest a limited or differently measured form; the contrast with gentle is clear.
plain_english: The inner creative intuition of the one lord of awareness is his body-form; whether gentle or another measured form, it is worshipped as the wheel of waves of awareness.
